a1-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Hello and Thanks
a1-01.scenario: Károly says hi to you at a café and offers you a tea.
a1-01.prompt: Say hi back, then accept the tea and thank him.
a1-01.canDo: I can greet someone and respond simply in Hungarian.

a1-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Is Who
a1-02.scenario: You meet Károly for the first time. Meg is with you.
a1-02.prompt: Say hi, say who you are (you are Anna), and tell him who she is.
a1-02.target: Szia! Én Anna vagyok. Ő Meg.
a1-02.canDo: I can say who I am.

a1-03.title: Communicative Challenge: What Is This?
a1-03.scenario: Károly puts something on the table that you don't recognize. Next to it is your book.
a1-03.prompt: Ask what it is. Then point to your book and say what it is.
a1-03.english: What is this? This is a book.
a1-03.canDo: I can ask what something is.

a1-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Not Me
a1-04.scenario: At the station a man asks you: Te Meg vagy? You are Anna.
a1-04.prompt: Say no, you're not Meg, say who you are, and ask if he is Károly.
a1-04.target: Nem, nem vagyok Meg. Anna vagyok. Te Károly vagy?
a1-04.english: No, I'm not Meg. I'm Anna. Are you Károly?
a1-04.canDo: I can ask and answer a yes/no question.

a1-05.title: Communicative Challenge: At Meg's
a1-05.scenario: You visit Meg. Károly is there too and hands you a cup.
a1-05.prompt: Greet Károly, ask what it is, and when he says it's a coffee, thank him.
a1-05.english: Hi, Károly! What is this? Thank you!
a1-05.canDo: I can use the core Unit 1 patterns in a short exchange.

a1-06.title: Communicative Challenge: Good Morning and Goodbye
a1-06.scenario: You meet Károly at the café in the morning. Later, when you leave, you say goodbye.
a1-06.prompt: Greet Károly with good morning, then say goodbye as you leave.
a1-06.canDo: I can greet someone and say goodbye at any time of day.

a1-07.title: Communicative Challenge: Please and Thank You
a1-07.scenario: Anna hands you a tea, but accidentally bumps your arm and apologizes.
a1-07.prompt: Thank Anna for the tea, and tell her that it's no problem.
cues: Say that it is no problem
a1-07.canDo: I can say please, thank you, and sorry in Hungarian.

a1-08.title: Communicative Challenge: How Are You?
a1-08.scenario: You run into Károly outside. He asks how you are doing.
a1-08.prompt: Tell Károly you are doing well, thank him, and ask how he is.
a1-08.canDo: I can use the new greetings and polite expressions.

a1-09.title: Communicative Challenge: Could You Repeat That?
a1-09.scenario: Mariann speaks very quickly and you do not catch what she said.
a1-09.prompt: Say you don't understand, and ask her to speak more slowly.
cues: Ask her to speak more slowly
a1-09.english: I don't understand. More slowly, please.
a1-09.canDo: I can use the new greetings and polite expressions.

a1-10.title: Communicative Challenge: Small Agreements
a1-10.scenario: András asks if you can wait five minutes before leaving.
a1-10.prompt: Agree to wait, then say of course.
a1-10.canDo: I can use the new greetings and polite expressions.

a1-10-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Morning Encounter
a1-10-consolidation.scenario: You meet Anna in the morning. She asks how you are.
a1-10-consolidation.prompt: Greet Anna with good morning, say you are well, and thank her.
a1-10-consolidation.canDo: I can greet people and say goodbye in Hungarian.
